- **Fault:** In scratch checkout only, edited `dashboard/server/retainedLandingDecision.ts` (`decideRetainedLanding` prepare branch) so a new prepare no longer appends `landing` into `landingReporting.preparations` (`preparations: [...retained.preparations]` instead of `[...retained.preparations, landing]`). Fixtures and assertions left intact. Equivalent to the plan’s “adapter skip the preparation carry-over” decision/adapter fault that loses the prepared pair through Done.
